features.libraryDesc: Create multiple independent libraries to organize assets by project or theme. Switch, rename, or delete libraries.
features.globalDesc: Global libraries share data across all worlds. Check the 'Global' option when creating to make the library visible and editable in any world. Ideal for common assets, shared textures, and cross-campaign content. Indicated by a globe icon.
features.folderDesc: Virtual folder structure — one asset can belong to multiple folders. Supports drag-to-sort, color coding, nesting, and folder drill-through browsing.
features.tagDesc: Add custom color-coded tags to assets. Smart suggestions based on filename tokenization and co-occurrence analysis.
features.filterDesc: Filter assets by file type, tags, or rating. Supports both fuzzy and exact search modes.
features.browserDesc: Browse the Foundry VTT data directory and drag files directly into your library. Supports directory navigation and file preview.
features.sceneDesc: Browse Compendium scene packs, preview scene maps (with tile layers), and import or activate scenes.
features.itemDesc: Bring world items under Origin Vault management for centralized browsing, import-state awareness, and follow-up organization. This is an advanced workflow feature.
features.previewDesc: Double-click for full preview with zoom/pan/rotate. Spacebar for Quick Look. Hover over video cards to scrub frames.
features.uploadDesc: Upload files or folders from your computer. Optional auto-conversion to WebP format to save space. Supports batch upload.
features.exportDesc: Export library config as a JSON backup, or import from a JSON file. Supports merge and overwrite modes.
features.canvasDesc: Drag assets directly onto the Foundry canvas to create Tiles or Ambient Sounds automatically.
features.pickerDesc: Automatically replaces the default Foundry FilePicker, so you can use Origin Vault wherever a file is needed.
